title: Felton v. Grace
disposition_detail: Case 97-1, George Felton v. Grace Presbytery, was withdrawn by the complainant; no merits disposition was published.
first_summary: Case 97-1, Felton v. Grace Presbytery, was withdrawn by the complainant. The notice does not state the underlying issue or any reason for withdrawal.
summary: A complaint docketed as Case 97-1, Felton v. Grace Presbytery, was withdrawn by the complainant in the 26th Assembly records. No merits opinion was published, and the available notice does not identify the challenged presbytery action, the grounds, or any reason for withdrawal. The practical effect was that the matter ended without any merits ruling or relief. It illustrates that a bare withdrawal entry supports only a status synopsis, not an inference about the merits.

sources.supports: Identity, procedural posture, withdrawal disposition, and absence of a merits opinion.
